entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer providing multi-level state for users, sessions, and agents. It utilizes hybrid retrieval and time-awareness to track both current state and past events.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: A high-performance memory engine featuring a custom vector graph and byte-level deduplication for sub-300ms recall. It manages persistent user profiles and offers native connectors for Notion, GitHub, Gmail, and Google Drive.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An open-source context database that uses a three-tier loading system to reduce token costs by 91%. It organizes memories via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agent that synthesizes cited answers with explicit gap analysis. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges that requires zero LLM calls for wiring.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term knowledge. It integrates with providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama via a simple LLM wrapper.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from events and conversations. It uses peer-centric modeling for users and projects combined with hybrid BM25 and vector search.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: A memory provider that treats context as a git repository, allowing for branching, merging, and versioning of markdown context trees. It offers five tiers of retrieval, four of which are non-LLM for sub-100ms speed.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that uses an iterative improvement loop of evaluation and distillation. It generates structured playbooks and traces to enable knowledge inheritance for complex tasks.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, SQLite-backed memory system delivering sub-millisecond latency. It combines a temporal knowledge graph with episodic memory and supports MCP clients like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin utilizing a hierarchical summary DAG for depth-aware compaction. It includes dedicated tools for grep and source-aware retrieval with built-in sensitive pattern redaction.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers and OpenAI-compatible providers via a Docker-based setup.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer using an open engram YAML format for multi-agent coordination. It features hierarchical scoping and an ACT-R based activation model for automatic memory decay.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It uses SQLite for custody and includes tools to manually edit or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that eliminates cloud dependencies and API keys. It employs a hybrid retrieval approach combining knowledge graphs, vector search, and BM25.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases prefill speed by 1.5–3× through prefix cache reuse. It reduces prompt token usage by approximately 36% across SGLang, vLLM, and Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It tracks contradictions and canonicalizes duplicates without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates graph truth, temporal continuity, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to reduce prompt noise.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that combines ranked graph traversal with BM25 full-text search. It automatically indexes URLs, local directories, and multimedia files using navigable edge tags.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces tool-schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tools. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings for Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database. It employs importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories first during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures true deletion of memories without leaving persistent summary artifacts. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: An integration for Exabase M-1 that provides self-organizing long-term memory. It includes tools for manual storage and configurable query expansion for improved retrieval.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system for macOS and Windows that integrates with coding agents via an MCP server. It provides Hermes Agent with access to over 100 skills, 150 design systems, and 261 plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports 26+ AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Enables the generation of draw.io diagrams from natural language, including ERDs, UML, and flowcharts. It can visualize codebase structures for Python, JS-TS, Go, and Rust using a library of 10,000+ shapes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution loops. It unifies skill libraries across teams and devices with native integration for Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place modes. It utilizes a two-pass detection system and a tiered word replacement table across 49 pattern categories.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io agents. It offers modular installation via npx or a plugin marketplace, with frameworks based on industry guidelines.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via dedicated slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure to reduce token usage. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A set of tools for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without relying on yt-dlp. It supports channel browsing and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Claude Code.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills, featuring automated security scanning with 65+ threat detection rules. It includes a creator marketplace with crypto and Stripe payment support.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using dynamic 'prisms' via the /prism-scan command. It includes seven validated prisms for simulation and optimization, with constraint reporting to find analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A set of workflow skills that transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A local-first Rust binary that manages long-running agents using a durable card model for tracking tasks and decisions. It ensures quality through proof and QA gates before shipping work.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into .lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Implements cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io-compliant skills for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These skills are installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures provenance through pinned commits and file:line citations, including full lifecycle tooling for versioning.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official FLUX image generation skills providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and polling, supporting precise hex color specifications.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification featuring an OpenAPI-driven Python client. It supports recursive dependency resolution and commerce flows via Stripe and TON.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token consumption. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture to support hot-reloading of server configurations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Allows Hermes Agent to manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure and integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model reasoning capabilities. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and exploits. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning and uses an MCP server to manage suppression rules.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code. It uses a risk-tiered triage system and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion to filter 100+ skills down to the five most relevant. This reduces token consumption through a non-invasive integration.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across various protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: A collection of Nix packages that enables instant execution of Hermes and other AI coding agents via nix run commands. It ensures tools stay current through daily automatic updates.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Provides scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs, including Hermes, on Android smartphones. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent access to mobile hardware and UI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop distribution featuring a GUI and 100 built-in tools. It supports local models via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for custom automation pipelines.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: A Termux-based deployment guide featuring a one-line installation script for rapid Android setup. It supports persistent memory and compatibility with over 200 AI models, including local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: A community Helm chart for Kubernetes deployments that implements cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer safety for persistent storage and supports both direct deployment and CRD-based workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: A security-focused deployment that sandboxes the agent with hardware-enforced kernel-level blocking of dangerous syscalls and network egress. It offers dynamic security policies ranging from strict to permissive access.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom tag builds.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package for declarative, reproducible deployments. It integrates sops-nix for secure secrets handling and manages agent configurations as systemd services.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready headless deployment that configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that allows users to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It provides hierarchy-aware task scheduling and inter-agent delegation across separate workspaces.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack designed for Portainer deployment that includes a ttyd web terminal for remote access. It utilizes GitHub Actions for automated image builds.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration stack that uses a zero-dependency SQLite backend to dispatch tasks and monitor spend. It provides multi-gateway support for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, featuring an Aegis review system for quality control.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project offers a TUI and PWA dashboard to monitor diverse coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, within isolated sandboxes. It enables parallel execution by leveraging git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template designed to scale from a single VPS agent to full specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control-room template uses a level-based architecture to transition from individual agents to automated, orchestrated workflows. It features a task bus for specialist handoffs and includes skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: An orchestration platform for building autonomous swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It provides visual org charts, durable agent memory, and support for scheduled runs.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A centralized mission control interface that uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues. It allows users to live-stream agent reasoning and perform human-in-the-loop verification on all completed tasks.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents through a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage tool handling and agent dialogue flows via a Kanban interface.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A specialized pipeline for end-to-end software development featuring 17 distinct agents for roles like research, implementation, and infrastructure. The system enforces mandatory quality gates through dedicated reviewer and tester agents.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization tool that uses automated outer-loop search to refine Hermes Agent harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. The platform orchestrates nine agents, including Hermes, and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize tasks and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: A delegation tool that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style workflows. It prevents parent context pollution through isolation and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that provides symbol relationships and call graphs to optimize agent performance. It reduces token consumption and tool calls by auto-syncing the graph on every file change.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A Rust-based TUI CLI tool designed to track token usage and costs across various AI coding agents. It provides cross-platform support for monitoring clients including Hermes, Claude Code, and Gemini.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic, allowing developers to analyze system prompts, tool schemas, and streaming responses. It features structured diffs for comparing requests and exports sessions to portable HTML files.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that acts as an autonomous CTO for issue triage and PR management. It bundles 23 skills and 5 workflows with integrations for Vercel, Supabase, GitHub, Sentry, and Uptime Kuma.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI themes and skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. It offers diverse aesthetics from retro DOS to cyberpunk through customizable colors, ASCII banners, and spinner verbs.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. This implementation removes the need for OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for vLLM and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that enables autonomous agent control via MCP while maintaining a human-visible UI for supervision. It supports durable state management with action undo and agent-specific bookmarks.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that allows for the creation of scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents using project-local memories and tools.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup utilizing RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes over 40 specialized skills for finance, research, and devops with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment stack that uses Docker to run Hermes Agent with LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant. It provides 29 community plugins and automates configuration for zero-cost local GPU inference.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts without using LLM calls. It employs seven structural detectors to identify agent failure modes and integrates directly into CI/CD pipelines.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps complex model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles the transfer of local and system-level credentials.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that provides a native interface for Hermes Agent and other CLI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers a unified way to handle multiple agent environments across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies various agent CLIs into a single interface. It features a built-in agent with MCP tool support and the ability to automatically generate editable .docx, .pptx, and .xlsx files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A lightweight web-based interface using Python and vanilla JavaScript that maintains full feature parity with the Hermes Agent CLI. It utilizes a three-panel layout for efficient workspace file browsing and inline previews.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It includes integrated management for scheduled tasks, memory, tools, and support for various local and remote AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard featuring session management, usage analytics, and integrated Kanban boards. It specializes in multi-platform channel configuration for services like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal, Monaco editor, and a dedicated memory browser. It introduces Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch using tmux-backed workers and an integrated MCP catalog.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It offers dedicated views for sessions, skills, and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health tracking and Kanban pipelines. It provides a full MCP server control plane with log tailing and a multi-profile streaming chat.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and 'agent cockpit' for tracking limits and analytics across Hermes and other coding agents. It uses local-only indexing to ensure privacy with no telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A macOS interface specifically optimized for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation on cloud VMs and integrated WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, tailored for Chinese users. It includes a built-in Hermes Agent kernel with health checks and integration for Feishu.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI that renders markdown, LaTeX, and tool calls. It allows for the management of profiles, memory, and toolsets through a terminal-based interface.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App for managing Hermes Agent on the go. It includes terminal chat with streaming responses and system health gauges for CPU and memory monitoring.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows portable GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker. It comes pre-loaded with over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and includes a dynamic tool maker for API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted, glassmorphic web interface built with React 18. It integrates a terminal, file browser, and real-time log streaming for managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring and configuration dashboard that provides a real-time activity feed via WebSockets. It offers read-only access to environment variables and FTS5 search for inspecting session histories.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for installing MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and a PM orchestrator for task management.
